mentions.name: Veneer
mentions.description: A thin facade over Google Forms/Sheets that turns them into polished web pages. It is a rewrite of an older version that currently powers viviblues.com, motivated by Vercel ending support for Node v18.
mentions.problem: Vercel is ending support for Node v18, so instead of updating the old app the author finished the rewrite of the better version.
